text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, McQueen? You seem rather
perplexed. Is
something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well... There's this movie, "Shogun
vs. Pastry
Chef vs. Alien!"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship invited me to go see it with
her, so we
were going to head to the
theater today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But  she canceled on me. She ran off
saying
"Sorry! Gotta go save the world!"
and left me with
both of the tickets...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Why, I'd love to go together
with you in
her place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I'm delighted you feel that way,
but I can't
promise that this movie would
be something
you'd enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But I love trying new things! Not to
mention... I
would be happy simply to
spend the day with
you, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh... That is, only if I'm not imposing, of
course...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. Actually... I feel I have
something
to learn from your spirit of
taking on new
experiences.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm not particularly interested in the film,
but if
it's to broaden our knowledge of
one another,
that's a different story. So,
let us make our way to
the theater.
